description: Local meeting capture and transcription: on-device (anarlog plugins) or private cloud (Exo's cloud_transcription_* commands). Applied at runtime only when the `transcription` Cargo feature is enabled. Grants exactly the commands the Local recording UI invokes; event listening comes from core:default. The webview may not emit events: Exo's native capture registry trusts the transcription plugin's `stopped` event, so the webview must not be able to forge one.
